Adaptive
Cruise Control
Speed held automatically, and given up when something is in the way.
  • Arduino Uno with an ultrasonic range sensor
  • Cruise and adaptive modes on an LCD readout
  • Braking when an object enters the gap
  • Modelled first in MATLAB and Simulink
